releases.summary: Daily Report history, R&D and KDT Wide Training reports, and Man-Hour Report billing updates.

added.title: Daily Report History
added.description: Users can review the history of changes to Daily Report entries, including what changed, previous and new values, who made the change, when it happened, and the affected report date.

added.title: Research & Development Manhour Report
added.description: A new R&D report is available for reviewing manhours recorded under R&D activities. Hours are organized by group and by the R&D activity entries maintained in Job Manhour Category.

added.title: KDT Wide Training Report
added.description: A new report in the same format as the R&D Manhour Report shows KDT Wide Training hours by group, employee, and activity.

changed.title: Man-Hour Report Billing
changed.description: KDT vs BU billing shares are no longer taken from percent labels in item names. Training items that used to split 50/50, plus Research & Development and KDT Wide Training, now bill 100% to KDT. Trainer for KHI Engineer remains billed to the BU.

changed.title: Supervisor Override Tracking
changed.description: Daily Report changes made through supervisor override are marked in history, including the supervisor who made the change and the fields that were changed.

modified.title: Clearer Change Details
modified.description: Daily Report updates show changed values in a clearer before-and-after format, making corrections easier to review.

modified.title: Improved History Experience
modified.description: The Daily Report history interface is easier to scan on laptop, tablet, and smaller screens.

releases.summary: Log KDT Wide Training hours in Daily Report.

added.title: KDT Wide Training Hours
added.description: Employees can now log KDT Wide Training hours in Daily Report under Training. Shared activities are People management training program and Work Evolution Guidance, maintained in Job Manhour Category.

releases.summary: Log Research & Development hours in Daily Report.

added.title: Research & Development Hours
added.description: Employees can now log Research & Development hours in Daily Report under KDT Internal Activities. Each group maintains its own R&D activity entries in Job Manhour Category.

releases.summary: Various improvements to reporting and user experience.

added.title: Daily Report locking for previous months

changed.title: Restricted Daily Report editing outside the editable month

releases.summary: Initial release with core reporting features.
